title: SOC2 evidence + vendor review TODOs - scratchpad
content:
Scratchpad for SOC2 evidence collection, vendor reviews, and policy TODOs. Rapid notes - not polished.

Overview:
- Working list of evidence artifacts we still need for CC1/CC3. Focus on: IAM, key management, vendor contracts, monitoring/config alerts, access reviews.
- Vendor reviews: Okta (SAML/OIDC), Datadog (logs/metrics retention), Sentry (error telemetry), AWS (KMS, CloudTrail), HashiCorp (Vault) - verify contracts + SOC reports.

Top priorities (high level):
- Get final snapshots for IAM role tables + permission sets (last 30 days).
- KMS key rotation proof and policy for customer key material (Private deployments).
- Vendor AARs (annual assurance reports): request updated SOC2 reports from Datadog & Sentry.
- Access review evidence for 2025 Q4 (screenshot + attestation).

Open questions / notes to self:
- Do we accept vendor subservice reports as-is or require supplemental AMAs? (ask Legal)
- For Dedicated customers, evidence for network isolation - need the network diagram (ask infra for latest).
- Need a concise narrative for auditors about our smart routing fallbacks (how to explain model variant fallback from infra perspective).

Evidence mapping (working):
- IAM (OK): export from AWS IAM console, list of role ARNs, permission boundaries. (owner: Priya)
- KMS (partial): rotation policy in docs, last rotation logs from CloudTrail. (owner: Samira)
- Logging/Monitoring (todo): Datadog retention settings + how alerts map to incident response runbook. (owner: Asha)
todo_items: [ ] Request updated SOC2 report from Datadog and Sentry (email legal@ and vendor contact)
[ ] Pull IAM role export for prod and staging (script: infra/tools/iam-export.sh) - include timestamped CSV
[ ] Get KMS rotation logs for customer-managed keys (CloudTrail slice: 2025-01-01..2026-02-28)
[ ] Ask infra for network diagram for Dedicated (vpc/subnet/CIDR mapping) and annotate for auditors
[ ] Compile access review attestations for 2025 Q4 (collect sign-offs from app owners)
[ ] Update 'access review' SOP doc to include checklist items auditors expect
[ ] Draft short narrative for auditors on routing & fallback behavior (how we mitigate degraded models)
[ ] Create folder in Evidence Drive and upload artifacts >= 2 copies (Confluence link + blob storage)
[ ] Schedule 30-min sync w/ Legal to confirm vendor report acceptance criteria (calendar invite)
[ ] Tag evidence artifacts with ticket id (SEC-243) and set status in JIRA
